# Cron

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, holds the `dark` theme, and keeps the 12 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Calendar-product marketing and changelog pages: a dark #161412 home over a #0f0d0a footer with #ccc text and the #ff4700 chronos Sign up pill glowing under --glow, 140px Helvetica Neue -3px-tracked hero (80px mobile), light Next.js blog/changelog/post pages with the declared 14-step --gray10..--gray900 ramp, --eclipse/--snow/--dieter/--urushi/--ratio named set, --elevation-* levels and a 676px article column.

Captured 2026-11-12, signed out (every captured surface is public; the Cron app, its Notion Calendar successor, docs and the demo sit behind Login/Sign up and outbound links, none of which was followed; nothing was submitted). Themes: light, dark.

Cron's public signed-out surface — the dark marketing home and the light Next.js content pages at /blog, /changelog and a /blog/<post> article — captured 2026-11-12 in headless Chromium at 1440 x 900, plus the home and blog at 390 x 844. Cron is now Notion Calendar (the banner says so); the app behind Login and Sign up was never entered, and nothing was submitted.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.
